title: Open-world fodder 3: the canyon, the Labyrinth, Othrys and the Underworld
prompt: A sheet of five blocky voxel monster kinds: a basilisk, a small quick crowned lizard with a crest and glowing yellow eyes spitting venom; an Earthborn, a big lumpy six-armed clay giant hurling mud balls and rocks; a Daedalus drone, a bronze clockwork bird with whirring wings and a glowing blue core, firing bolts; a Laistrygonian, a huge tattooed cannibal giant in furs lobbing flaming bronze balls; and keres, ragged black death spirits with skull faces, bat wings and red claws, swooping fast in a flock. Each kind shown three times (front, side, mid-attack) beside a blocky Percy for scale, readable from the high three-quarter camera, with a strong silhouette and a bold colour accent so it reads in a crowd, and a cool, characterful design worth seeing a hundred times. 3D game art in the blocky voxel style of Minecraft Dungeons: characters built from cubes, with a large cube head whose face is simple pixel art (about 8 × 8 pixels: pixel eyes, a pixel mouth, hair drawn as pixels and as a few blocky tufts), a boxy torso, square arms and legs, crisp pixel-art textures (about 16 pixels per block) with simple shading, chunky readable silhouettes; warm cinematic lighting, soft ambient occlusion and glowing magic effects. Costume colours and details follow the Camp Half-Blood cartoon concept art. Palette: camp orange #f28c28, sea teal #0f6f73, deep navy #10233d, jade #2e8b6e, coral #e8664a, bronze gold #c9963a, lightning yellow #ffd84a, parchment cream #f4ead5, vase black #17130f and owl grey #8c96a3. Flat light-grey background. No lettering, logos, captions or watermark.
